coverage: Only optional operator-configured GitHub SSH deployment access is registered here. Provider accounts, machine SSH access and other installation credentials are not inventoried by this manifest.

entries.purpose: Optional read-only access to this repository from an operator-configured deployment checkout
entries.recovery: On the deployment machine, inspect checkout-local origin and core.sshCommand to locate the selected private key and trusted-host file. The private key stays on that server and is not backed up by this project. If lost or compromised, generate a dedicated replacement, register its public key as a read-only deploy key for this repository, verify GitHub host identity and SSH ls-remote, then revoke the old deploy key. See docs/public-usage.md#deployment-git-transport. HTTPS installations do not require this credential.
